caption: Valley National Bank v. Burrini's Olde World Market, Inc.
citation_line: Valley National Bank v. Burrini's Olde World Market, Inc., No. 2:22-cv-00919, ECF No. 18 (D.N.J. July 29, 2022)
headnote_district_ruling: Recommended remand of an eviction action removed by a nonparty based on a related bankruptcy. Reading § 1452(a)'s reference to a 'party' according to its ordinary meaning, the court held that the bankruptcy debtor lacked authority to remove the case.
qualification_rationale: A careful bankruptcy-removal opinion on an infrequently litigated threshold question, with a textual analysis independently adopted by the district court.
appellate_posture_note: Adopted after objections on October 25, 2022, ECF Nos. 23–24; no appellate review identified.
